android.desc: LifeUp turns your real-life tasks, habits, and goals into an RPG adventure. Build skills, earn coins, unlock achievements, and design your own reward system. One-time purchase. No ads. No subscriptions. Ever. One-Time Purchase - Own It Forever Pay once, keep everything. No monthly fees, no paywalls, no ads. Every feature is included. If you uninstall within the Google Play refund window, you get an automatic refund. Not satisfied within 7 days of purchase? Email us for a manual refund - no questions asked. quotes.text:
Well you have this at roughly $2000 total: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.sarasarasa.lifeup

And this at almost a million dollars: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.modelmakertools.simplemindpro

I'm not sure if these are outliers, and my "random" sampling is just picking out highly visible apps. But I've made good money off an app built in a month, and I've made relatively little from a book written in 3 months.

Software has a lot more variety. You can make say, a communist themed productivity app vs a forest themed one and these will appeal to different people.
quotes.story_title: Writing books is not really a good idea
